info.title: HND Logistech Web Application API
info.description:
API documentation for HND Logistech.

> **Architectural Note**: This API adheres to the 'World-Class' standards defined in `.aicontext.md`. All ID fields are UUIDs, and responses follow the strict `{status, code, msg, data}` format.
